scope: Standard-library build-storage maintenance: temporary-filesystem qualification on Linux and Windows, configured CTest, read-only inspection and guarded application to one explicitly retired CMake build.

contract.compiler_output_ownership: Literal generated Ninja C/C++/ASM compiler outputs in constrained CMakeFiles target or root obj namespaces; source/input/evidence prefixes excluded.
formats: bounded ordinary and bigobj COFF relocatable
CMake-named GCC or Clang PCH signatures

windows.skip_reason: The test process cannot create Windows symbolic links without the required privileges.
windows.reparse_attribute_check: Synthetic reparse-attribute refusal test; not a native junction creation test.

retired_root_application.scope: One retired Linux CMake build on a Windows-mounted filesystem; no active workflow input selected.

coverage: report leaves files unchanged; binaries, sources, reports and non-object .o data retained
explicit protected/current-preset roots and unsupported preset syntax refuse cleanup
thin archives, linked ancestry, hardlinks, reparse attributes and new Ninja locks refuse cleanup
unproven vendor/prebuilt/source/evidence objects excluded despite valid object bytes
ordinary/bigobj COFF, bounded ELF and CMake PCH recognition; malformed/truncated files preserved
plan hash/freshness and same-size/same-mtime content changes checked before deletion
late file changes stop apply with explicit completed subset
exclusive plan creation and forward-slash Windows path labels
limits: Temporary-filesystem cases are separate from the one retired-build application. Recovery size is a local observation, not a general disk-space saving guarantee.
All selected roots must be retired and have no live writers or consumers, including thin archives outside selected roots; selected-tree scanning cannot discover those external references.
Portable path/identity checks are not held-handle deletion, atomic compare-and-unlink or adversarial filesystem isolation.
No global process census, process containment or guarantee of safety for an active build.
Windows actual symlink tests were skipped for unavailable privileges; synthetic reparse refusal does not qualify real junction transitions.
Unknown Ninja variables/rules, Makefile-only ownership and unsupported formats remain untouched; preset syntax not understood by the helper fails closed.
